title: Analysis of a Conforming Finite Element Method for Second-Harmonic Generation Scattering
summary: In the frequency domain, nonlinear acoustic and electromagnetic wave propagation can, in certain regimes, be modeled by second-harmonic generation systems consisting of two coupled nonlinear Helmholtz equations. We analyze a conforming finite element approximation of a scalar second-harmonic generation scattering problem truncated using an exact Dirichlet-to-Neumann boundary condition. The discretization uses continuous piecewise polynomial finite elements of degree $p$.
